title: Wake-up call
instructions: Bir misafir otel resepsiyonuyla uyandırma servisi ve taksi için konuşuyor. Saatleri ve hesapları dikkatle takip et. Bu sette 3 dinleme hakkın var.

script.speaker: guest
script.text: Hello, this is room 512. I'd like a wake-up call tomorrow, please.

script.speaker: guest
script.text: My flight is at nine. I need to be at the airport two hours before.

script.speaker: rec
script.text: The airport is forty-five minutes away by taxi. Shall I book one for you?

script.speaker: guest
script.text: Yes, please. For a quarter past six. And the wake-up call at half past five.

script.speaker: rec
script.text: Breakfast starts at six thirty. Would you like a breakfast box to take with you?

script.speaker: guest
script.text: That would be great. Is it free?

script.speaker: rec
script.text: Yes, it's included in your room price.

questions.prompt: What is Mr Lee's room number?
What time does Mr Lee need to be at the airport?
questions.feedback: Uçuş dokuzda, iki saat önce orada olmalı: yedi.
questions.evidence: I need to be at the airport two hours before.

questions.prompt: Why will Mr Lee get a breakfast box?
questions.feedback: Kahvaltı altı buçukta başlıyor; o saatte taksiyle çıkmış olacak.

questions.prompt: How much is the breakfast box?
questions.evidence: Yes, it's included in your room price.
